description: This file defines a PHP class 'PartialEmployee' within the OrangeHRM project. The class contains properties for employee ID and work email, along with getter and setter methods. It also provides a static method to create an instance from an 'Employee' object. It appears to be part of the LDAP plugin for OrangeHRM, specifically in the DTO (Data Transfer Object) namespace, likely used for transferring partial employee data during LDAP authentication processes.

classes.name: PartialEmployee
classes.description: A data transfer object representing partial employee information, including employee ID and work email, with convenience methods for object creation from Employee entities.

methods.name: getEmployeeId
methods.description: Returns the employee ID if set, otherwise null.

methods.name: setEmployeeId
methods.description: Sets the employee ID property and returns the instance for method chaining.

methods.name: getWorkEmail
methods.description: Returns the work email if set, otherwise null.

methods.name: setWorkEmail
methods.description: Sets the work email property and returns the instance for method chaining.

methods.name: createFromEmployee
methods.description: Creates an instance of PartialEmployee from a given Employee object, copying employee ID and work email.
